history.content: Buying an investment property in Australia - what are the advantages and disadvantages of building a house vs buying an existing one?
I am sorry that I do not have the information, so I am not about to provide the comparison between building and buying a house in Australia.
What should I watch out if I decide to buy a house in Australia?

You should watch out 1). interest rate rise of 2% above current rates to make sure that it is affordable; 2). make sure to hire team to do inspection on the home before you buy; 3). please keep in mind of the property value of the house might go down every year.
do you think buying an investment property is good in general?

In general, buying a property and renting it out can be a good investment if it matches your long term goals. Additionally, starting your investment in multi-family is a great idea. It is a good way to gain experience in real estate while exponentially increasing cash flow. However, some people are against it since there can be a number of serious risks to property investment.
